newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen in range before rise resumes.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen in range before rise resumes.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA40
Cocoa is still consolidating in the 1,097 to 1,140 stg range, before a likely new move higher, analysts said on Monday.
Traders ssaw the market opening unchanged.

"One would expect the upmove to resume fairly soon," Adrian Haylor, analyst at Sucden said. Even if the immediate support at 1,097 stg a tonne were broken, there was a raft of support at around 1,070, he said. "If 1,097 doesn't hold, 1,070 will," Haylor said.
Although there was initial resistance at 1,140 stg, 1,172 was a much more important level. "1,172 is the level everyone's looking at," Haylor said.
In New York, cocoa futures ended sharply lower and toward the bottom of the day's range on Friday, pressured by speculative profit-taking on the heels of Thursday's strong gains, dealers said.
LIFFE cocoa futures retraced to finish broadly lower on Friday after an early breakthrough to new one-year high faltered on pre-weekend selling, traders said.
